summary.text: Patricia A. Serpa is a Democrat who has represented House District 27 (West Warwick, Coventry and Warwick) since first being elected in 2006; she chairs the House Oversight Committee and is second vice chair of the House Rules Committee.

paragraphs.text: Serpa has chaired the Committee on Oversight since May 2016, and her biography says its work on state agency failures led her to sponsor a 2024 law setting rules for non-emergency medical transportation.
She is also a member of the House Conduct Committee and the House Corporations Committee.

The biography lists 2025 laws she introduced requiring nonprofits to disclose top salaries before receiving legislative grants and making bid rigging unlawful, and a 2024 law allowing independent voters in primaries to automatically disaffiliate.
